newsitem.title: ITALY: Technical hitch delays Naples city May CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Technical hitch delays Naples city May CPI data.

text.p: A technical hitch in the city of Naples statistics office was delaying publication of the city's May consumer price inflation data, town hall officials said.
There was no immediate indication as to when the figures would be released.
Naples is one of 11 Italian cities due to publish inflation data on Tuesday and Wednesday. The city's CPI weighs 6.64 percent on the national index.
